1: A man who once aimed for the UFC title becomes the bouncer of a small seaside bar.
2: But the craziest fighter in the world comes to get rid of him.
3: Who will survive the fight between these two men?
5: One night, an underground bare-knuckle fight club where people bet money.
6: The man who steps up to challenge the champion is none other than Dalton.
7: But the moment the opponent sees Dalton's face, he gets scared and forfeits the fight.
8: Dalton takes the prize money without fighting, and a man who lost his bet cannot hold back his anger.
9: A woman who watched follows Dalton, and there is a knife stuck in his side.
10: Her name is Frankie. She runs a bar on the Florida coast and has trouble with violent customers every night.
11: She offers him five thousand dollars a week to work as her bouncer for a month.
12: Dalton refuses, but Frankie leaves him her phone number.
13: Dalton lives in his car with nowhere to go. He was once a fighter who nearly won the UFC middleweight title.
14: He no longer even watches fights on TV. In the end he drives to Florida.
15: He arrives at the small island town of Glass Key, and Charlie, the bookstore owner's daughter, greets him.
16: When he says he came to fix a bar's problems, Charlie gets excited that it is like a western.
17: He arrives at the seaside bar, and the staff recognize who he is right away.
18: But at night the peaceful bar quickly turns into chaos.
19: A biker gang starts harassing the bartender and causing trouble.
20: Dalton smiles, walks over, and asks them to step outside for a talk.
21: Before the fight starts, he strangely asks whether they have medical insurance.
22: He asks how far the nearest hospital is and even tries to calm his opponent down.
23: But fists fly, and Dalton takes down the gang in the blink of an eye.
24: Then he drives the injured bikers to the hospital himself.
25: Ellie, the ER doctor, does not like Dalton.
26: Dalton's hand is bleeding too. Asked why he fights, he answers.
27: Dalton refuses stitches, saying it was his fault and he will pay the price.
28: The next day Frankie pays him his weekly wage in cash as promised. She believes this place can be special.
29: She gives him an old boat at the marina as a place to stay.
30: That night Dalton has a nightmare again, about the day he beat his friend in the ring.
31: In the morning, bar staff Laura brings him food. She says the previous bouncers did not last more than a few days.
32: At the bookstore, Charlie tells Dalton about a western hero who resembles him.
33: When the gang steals from the bookstore, Charlie confronts them with a bat.
34: Charlie's mother died last year, and the bookstore was her mother's dream.
35: Meanwhile on a yacht, Ben Brandt, the real boss of the gang, gets a report.
36: Told that Dalton looks nice but suddenly explodes, Ben cannot hide his irritation.
37: Ben wants to destroy the bar at any cost, but no one knows why.
38: That night, a customer with a hidden knife picks a fight with the band.
39: Dalton teaches the staff how to fight, and they start handling the customers one by one.
40: He even recruits a customer who used to box, and the nights at the bar get quieter.
41: Drunk customers are sent home in taxis, and Dalton brings order step by step.
42: Meeting Ellie again at a diner, she warns him that on this island family and loyalty come before the law.
43: She tells him about pink pearls: extreme irritation creates something beautiful.
44: Frankie tells him about her uncle who first opened the bar. It was not easy to keep a place like this in the South back then.
45: That night a truck hits Dalton as he walks home. The driver is Dell, the gang leader.
46: When Dalton barely makes it back to his boat, Dell is waiting inside with a gun.
47: Dalton asks why, since he is just a drifter, and Dell shouts that it is about the bar.
48: After a fight, Dell falls into the water. Dalton tries to hold him with a rope, but it is no use.
49: There are crocodiles in the water. Dell's body is never found.
50: Dalton suspects the gang wants to use the back of the bar as a drug delivery route.
51: But boats cannot even reach the bar's shore because of the reef.
52: Later, Ben's men come for Dalton and point a gun, telling him to get in the car.
53: Dalton says the gun in his waistband does not scare him and breaks two of the man's fingers.
54: He tells him to tell his boss that he will be at the bar every night.
55: Frankie is actually relieved that Dell is dead. He had terrorized the bar for months.
56: Asked why the gang is so obsessed with the bar, Frankie changes the subject.
57: Seeing his henchman with broken fingers, Ben is furious.
58: Then Ben's father, who is in prison, makes a phone call to someone.
59: The man who takes the call is smiling calmly after setting a clothing market on fire.
60: Meanwhile Ellie takes Dalton out to the middle of the sea on a boat.
61: She tells him the people he crossed are the Brandt family, who developed most of the island.
62: But asked where he is from, Dalton suddenly goes quiet and asks to go back.
63: Ellie already knows all about his past.
64: Around then, a stranger shows up at Ben's house, knocks over motorcycles and beats up the gang.
65: His name is Knox, a fixer sent by Ben's father from prison.
66: Knox says Ben is ruining the job and the bouncer is already a dead man.
67: Ben says he will try the easy way one more time, and after that Knox can burn it all.
68: The next day the sheriff takes Dalton away. The sheriff is Ellie's father.
69: The sheriff warns him to leave the island or be framed and sent to prison.
70: In the end Dalton is dragged out of the car and surrounded by the sheriff's men.
71: Ellie confesses that her father has worked for the Brandt family for a long time.
72: That night, Ben shows up at the bar himself.
73: Ben shows a video that was removed from the internet: Dalton beating his friend in the ring.
74: Asked why he did not stop when he had already won, Dalton cannot answer.
75: That night, Knox storms into the bar with the gang.
76: Knox picks fights with customers and drags the band off the stage. The whole bar turns into chaos.
77: Finally face to face, Knox says he came here only for Dalton.
78: The two exchange punches and the bar is smashed to pieces.
79: When the police arrive, Knox leaves, saying Dalton is not normal.
80: In the chaos, bartender Billy is badly hurt. He was hit with a golf club.
81: Dalton packs his bags, and only then does Frankie tell him the truth.
82: Asked if he is that scared, Dalton answers honestly.
83: Hearing that Knox did not kill Dalton, Ben gets nervous.
84: Meanwhile Charlie's bookstore goes up in flames, and Charlie and her father are taken to the hospital.
85: That night Dalton appears in front of the gang that set the fire.
86: Saying he was about to leave, Dalton breaks the man's neck with a single blow.
87: He says what really scares him is himself, what happens when someone pushes him.
88: From a gang member, Dalton learns that Ben collects money at Harvest Key at dawn.
89: At that moment he remembers the ring, beating his fallen friend without stopping.
90: At dawn, Dalton raids the money drop. The men guarding the money bag are the sheriff's deputies.
91: Dalton admits that once he gets angry, he cannot stop.
92: He even calls the Coast Guard and the newspaper himself.
93: But the sheriff comes and begs for help, saying Ben kidnapped Ellie.
94: Dalton agrees to bring the money and borrows a speedboat to go out to sea.
95: Meanwhile Knox shows up at Ben's house driving a student driver car, but the house is empty.
96: Dalton boards Ben's yacht. There was no kidnapping; it was a trap set up by the sheriff and Ben.
97: But Ben betrays the sheriff too, and he really is holding Ellie.
98: When Dalton says he has no money, Ben threatens to hurt Ellie.
99: Then Knox approaches the yacht in a boat, and an explosion goes off on the yacht.
100: The yacht is engulfed in flames, and Dalton dives into the sinking cabin to rescue Ellie.
101: But Ben grabs Ellie again and flees, saying he will destroy the bar himself.
102: Dalton and Knox fight again on a boat.
103: After knocking Knox into the sea, Dalton chases Ben by boat.
104: Struggling with Ellie, Ben's boat crashes straight into the bar.
105: Meanwhile Knox, who fell into the sea, climbs up onto a bridge.
106: In the wrecked bar Dalton finds Ben, who desperately throws a harpoon.
107: And at last the final fight between Dalton and Knox begins.
108: The two push each other until they are covered in blood.
109: Ben yells at Knox to kill him, but it is Knox who silences Ben.
110: Knox grabs a wooden shard, and Dalton uses his last strength to take Knox down.
111: The sheriff tells Dalton to leave now and says it will be as if he was never here.
112: At the wrecked bar, they start getting ready to welcome customers again.
113: As Dalton is about to board the bus, Charlie asks if he will just disappear into the sunset.
114: Leaving the bag of money to Charlie's father, Dalton leaves the island on the bus.
115: But during the end credits, Knox, thought dead, bursts out through the hospital doors.
